村正《敵騎、捕捉！》
景明「応！」

en.html:
I rushed to the field.
Late. So late that even this doubt came: perhaps I was running toward a time that had already finished.

Not now. This doubt, not now.
Believe there is time left. Run as though every instant, every hair's breadth is the last one available.

ja.html:
馳せ参ず。
　余りにも遅きに失し、あるいは、間に合わなかった
のではないか――という疑念さえ<ruby>過<rt>よ</rt></ruby>ぎるも。

　今は迷いを抱くべからず。
　時に残余があるを信じ、一瞬一毫を惜しんで駆ける。

en.html:
The enemy's enormous body stood directly ahead.
On the ground. Not moving, for now.

Just before this, something had gone wrong with its flight. The monster had come down in a forced landing; only now was it showing signs of starting again.

No attack had seemed to hit it, from any direction. Then why—
Later. The thinking can also wait its turn.

ja.html:
敵の巨躯は正面に有り。
　地表にあって今は不動。

　直前、何事があったのか、かの怪鬼は騎航を乱して
不時着している。
　いま漸う、動き出そうとする気配がある。

　何処からも攻撃を受けたようには見えなかったが。
　――そんな思索も後で良し。

en.html:
Straight ahead.

The tsurugi's sensors, or its pilot's instinct: something seemed to have warned it. With a speed I had not budgeted for in that enormous body, the warrior swung round to face me.

The gunports turned—
Fire came out.
en.text:
Straight ahead.

The tsurugi's sensors, or its pilot's instinct: something seemed to have warned it. With a speed I had not budgeted for in that enormous body, the warrior swung round to face me.

The gunports turned—
Fire came out.

ja.html:
ひた進む。

　劔冑の探査機能か、あるいは仕手の直感か、
　察したらしい巨大な武者は予想以上に素早い動きで、
こちらへ主攻正面を転換する。

　砲門群が向く――
　火を噴き放つ。

en.html:
I went straight into it.
To take notice would also require strength. That much surplus was not there.

Steel grains scraped away armour. More grains arrived to scrape the same place. Such precise, concentrated shooting: how many seconds before this iron wall finished and the soft flesh began?

The thought flashed.
Then even that was gone.

Go.
Forward only.

That one point I had memorised.
The single weakness that could bring down all this greatness.

The pilot's seat.
Toward that.

Go.

ja.html:
委細構わず突き進む。
　構うだけの余力もない。

　鋼の粒が甲鉄を削り、続く粒が更に削る。
　卓抜した射撃技量の成し遂げる集中弾が鉄壁を破り
脆弱な肉に到達するまで、あと何秒が要るのであろう。

　そんな危惧が刹那ひらめき、
　そのまま忘れる。

　今は行け。
　ただ前へ進め。

　記憶したその一点。
　偉容を崩し得る唯一の急所。

　仕手の搭乗位置。
　其処を目掛け。

　進む。
